label: Agriculture
description: Study of crops, livestock, soil, farm business, and food production systems.
good_fit_if: You like working outdoors, science, and solving problems in how food is grown.

label: Natural Resources and Conservation
description: Study of forests, water, wildlife, and ecosystems, and how to manage and protect them.
good_fit_if: You care about the environment and enjoy fieldwork, nature, and science.

label: Architecture
description: Study of designing buildings and spaces, combining art, engineering, and planning. Becoming a licensed architect usually requires a professional degree and licensing exam.
good_fit_if: You like drawing, design, math, and imagining how spaces work for people.

label: Ethnic, Cultural and Gender Studies
description: Study of the history, culture, and social experiences of different communities, with a focus on identity, power, and society.
good_fit_if: You like discussion, reading, writing, and understanding how culture and society shape people's lives.

label: Communication and Journalism
description: Study of media, public speaking, writing, advertising, and how information is shared with audiences.
good_fit_if: You like writing, speaking, storytelling, and current events.

label: Communications Technology
description: Hands-on study of the tools behind media, such as audio, video, broadcast, and multimedia production.
good_fit_if: You like cameras, editing software, sound, and making videos or media.

label: Computer Science
description: Study of programming, algorithms, software, and how computer systems work. Involves math, logic, and problem solving.
good_fit_if: You like math, puzzles, building things, and working on a computer.

label: Culinary and Personal Services
description: Career-focused study of cooking, hospitality, cosmetology, and other personal service trades. Often completed in a certificate or associate program.
good_fit_if: You like hands-on work, creativity, and working directly with customers.

label: Education
description: Study of teaching and learning, with classroom practice to prepare for teaching certification.
good_fit_if: You enjoy explaining things, working with kids or teens, and helping others learn.

label: Engineering
description: Study of applying math and science to design and build things, with branches such as mechanical, electrical, civil, chemical, and biomedical.
good_fit_if: You like math and physics, building or fixing things, and solving technical problems.

label: Engineering Technology
description: A more hands-on, applied version of engineering that focuses on building, testing, and maintaining real systems.
good_fit_if: You prefer working with equipment and real systems over heavy theory.

label: Foreign Languages
description: Study of languages, literature, and cultures, building fluency in speaking, reading, and writing.
good_fit_if: You love languages, travel, and learning about other cultures.

label: Family and Consumer Sciences
description: Study of human development, nutrition, family relationships, and household and consumer resources.
good_fit_if: You care about families, health, nutrition, and practical life skills.

label: Legal Studies
description: Study of law and the legal system. Becoming a lawyer requires law school after a bachelor's degree, while paralegal work needs less schooling.
good_fit_if: You like debate, reading, writing, logic, and fairness.

label: English
description: Study of literature, writing, and critical analysis, building strong reading and communication skills.
good_fit_if: You love reading and writing and enjoy analyzing stories and ideas.

label: Humanities
description: Broad study of human thought and culture across literature, history, philosophy, and the arts.
good_fit_if: You're curious about big questions and like reading, discussion, and writing.

label: Library Science
description: Study of organizing, managing, and sharing information. A librarian role usually requires a master's degree.
good_fit_if: You like research, organizing information, and helping people find answers.

label: Biology
description: Study of living things, from cells and genetics to ecosystems. Often leads to medicine, research, or environmental work.
good_fit_if: You're curious about how life works and enjoy lab work and detailed observation.

label: Mathematics and Statistics
description: Study of math theory, data, and statistics, building strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
good_fit_if: You enjoy math, patterns, logic, and working with numbers and data.

label: Military Technologies
description: Study of technical skills for military operations and defense. Most students in this area are already in or entering military service.
good_fit_if: You're interested in military service, technology, and structured teamwork.

label: Interdisciplinary Studies
description: Flexible study that combines several subjects into a custom program, such as neuroscience or environmental studies.
good_fit_if: Your interests don't fit one box and you want to build your own mix of subjects.

label: Parks, Recreation and Fitness
description: Study of exercise science, sports, recreation management, and public health through physical activity.
good_fit_if: You love sports, fitness, the outdoors, and helping people stay active.

label: Philosophy and Religious Studies
description: Study of ethics, logic, belief systems, and big questions about knowledge and meaning.
careers: Teacher or professor (often requires graduate degree)
good_fit_if: You like asking why, debating ideas, and thinking carefully about arguments.

label: Theology
description: Study of religious texts, doctrine, and ministry in preparation for religious leadership or service.
good_fit_if: You feel called to faith-based service, teaching, or community leadership.

label: Physical Sciences
description: Study of chemistry, physics, earth science, and astronomy, focusing on how the physical world works.
good_fit_if: You like physics and chemistry, experiments, and explaining how nature works.

label: Science Technologies
description: Applied, technician-level study of lab and scientific technology, such as clinical lab work and biotech.
good_fit_if: You like lab equipment and hands-on science without a long research degree.

label: Psychology
description: Study of the mind, behavior, and mental health. Counseling and clinical practice usually require a graduate degree and licensing.
good_fit_if: You're curious about why people think and act the way they do and want to help others.

label: Criminal Justice and Security
description: Study of the justice system, policing, corrections, and public safety.
good_fit_if: You're interested in public safety, fairness, and working in the justice system.

label: Public Administration and Social Service
description: Study of running government and nonprofit programs and helping communities, including social work.
good_fit_if: You want to help people and improve communities through public or nonprofit work.

label: Social Sciences
description: Study of society and human behavior through fields like economics, sociology, political science, and anthropology.
good_fit_if: You like understanding how societies, economies, and governments work.

label: Construction Trades
description: Hands-on training in building trades like carpentry, electrical work, plumbing, and HVAC, often through apprenticeships or certificate programs.
good_fit_if: You like working with your hands, building things, and earning while you learn.

label: Mechanic and Repair Technologies
description: Hands-on training in repairing and maintaining vehicles, equipment, and systems.
good_fit_if: You like fixing engines and machines and figuring out why something is broken.

label: Precision Production
description: Hands-on training in skilled manufacturing trades like welding, machining, and fabrication.
good_fit_if: You like precise handwork, tools, and making physical products.

label: Transportation
description: Study of operating and managing transportation systems, including aviation, maritime, and logistics.
good_fit_if: You're interested in planes, ships, trucks, and keeping goods and people moving.

label: Visual and Performing Arts
description: Study of art, design, music, theater, and film, combining creative practice with technical skill.
good_fit_if: You love creating things and expressing ideas visually, musically, or on stage.

label: Health Professions
description: Study of healthcare, including nursing, therapy, and public health. Some roles, such as doctor or physical therapist, need extra graduate school.
good_fit_if: You want to help people directly and are comfortable with science and working with patients.

label: Business and Marketing
description: Study of how organizations run, including management, accounting, finance, and marketing.
good_fit_if: You like leadership, money, strategy, persuading people, and starting or running things.

label: History
description: Study of past events, societies, and cultures through research, reading, and writing.
good_fit_if: You like stories, research, and understanding how the past shapes the present.
